description: Header file defining the GpuStats class, which manages GPU driver and application statistics, including insertion, dumping, and callback registration within the Android graphics environment.

classes.name: GpuStats
classes.description: Manages GPU statistics, including driver and app stats, with methods for data insertion, dumping, and callback handling.

methods.name: insertDriverStats
methods.description: Inserts new GPU driver statistics into global and app-specific records.

methods.name: insertTargetStats
methods.description: Inserts target statistics for a specific app and driver version.

methods.name: insertTargetStatsArray
methods.description: Inserts an array of target statistics for a specific app and driver version.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs current GPU stats based on provided arguments.

methods.name: purgeOldDriverStats
methods.description: Removes outdated driver statistics from records.

methods.name: pullGlobalInfoAtom
methods.description: Pulls global GPU info into statsd.

methods.name: pullAppInfoAtom
methods.description: Pulls app-specific GPU info into statsd.

methods.name: dumpGlobalLocked
methods.description: Dumps global GPU statistics to a string.

methods.name: dumpAppLocked
methods.description: Dumps app-specific GPU statistics to a string.

methods.name: interceptSystemDriverStatsLocked
methods.description: Appends system driver version info to stats.

methods.name: registerStatsdCallbacksIfNeeded
methods.description: Registers callbacks for statsd if not already registered.
